title: She Reused My Logo For Free. I Sent The Real Bill.
script: A boutique client hired me to design her shop's logo and brand kit for $3,000, half up front. When I sent the final files, she said the team wasn't feeling it and refused the second payment, then quietly launched her new site three weeks later using my exact logo. I hadn't sent the source files, only flattened previews, and my contract had one line she never read: unlicensed use of unpaid work billed at four times the original rate, per instance. I sent an invoice for $12,000 citing that clause, with screenshots of her live site as proof. Her lawyer called it outrageous. I forwarded the signed contract with her own signature on page three. Three days later the full $12,000 landed in my account, on top of my original $1,500 balance. She rebranded again within a month, paying full price to a different designer this time. I kept the original file, framed the invoice, and left her a five-star review from an account she never traced back to me.
